BuildingBlockModule.name: Modules.Payment.Domain

ModuleMeta.Name: Payment Domain
ModuleMeta.Description: Domain entities and services for payment processing in the ReSys eCommerce platform. Ported from Spree::Payment, Spree::PaymentMethod, Spree::Gateway, Spree::StoreCredit, Spree::CreditCard, Spree::Refund, Spree::RefundReason, and all supporting models. Provides payment lifecycle management (authorize, capture, void, credit), gateway abstraction, store credit issuance and redemption, and refund processing.
ModuleMeta.StandardsAlignment: DDD tactical patterns (Entity, Entity, Result pattern); CAT-labeled per Code Commenting Standard v3.0

Principle.name: Direct Ruby Port
Principle.Description: Business logic is ported directly from ruby-sdk-1/ Spree models, not from TypeScript middleman.
Principle.Rationale: Ensures all Ruby concerns, edge cases, and business rules are preserved in the C# domain.

Principle.name: Sealed Partial Pattern
Principle.Description: Each domain entity uses sealed partial class with one concern per partial file.
Principle.Rationale: Keeps entities extensible without violating single-responsibility; concern partials can be added independently.

Principle.name: Gateway Abstraction
Principle.Description: Gateway communication is abstracted behind IPaymentGatewayActionProvider; concrete providers live in Infrastructure.
Principle.Rationale: Domain logic remains independent of payment provider implementations; supports testability via BogusGateway.

Principle.name: Result Pattern
Principle.Description: All service methods return Result<T> — never throw for business rule violations.
Principle.Rationale: Ensures predictable error handling at domain boundaries; aligns with BuildingBlocks conventions.

Category.name: Payments
Category.Description: Payment lifecycle — creation, authorization, capture, void, credit, and gateway processing.

Abstraction.name: Payment
Abstraction.Description: Aggregate root tracking payment amount, state machine (Checkout → Processing → Pending → Completed/Failed/Void), and gateway response codes.
Abstraction.Purpose: Central payment entity — every transaction flows through Payment.
Abstraction.Contract: Invariant: Amount > 0; State follows Checkout -> Processing -> Pending -> Completed or -> Failed -> Void; captured total <= Amount
Abstraction.TopUse: Process an order payment through the gateway pipeline.

Abstraction.name: PaymentExtensions
Abstraction.Description: Static extension methods for Payment: Create, Process, Pend, Complete, Fail, Void, Invalidate, CreditAllowed, CanCapture, Capture.
Abstraction.Purpose: Factory and state transition methods keeping entity anemic per DDD convention.

Methods.Method: Mark as completed after gateway confirmation
Mark as failed on gateway error or decline
Void to prevent capture before settlement

Abstraction.name: PaymentProcessing
Abstraction.Description: Gateway interaction operations — port of Spree::Payment::Processing concern. Authorize, Purchase, Capture, Void, Cancel, Credit via IPaymentGatewayActionProvider.
Abstraction.Purpose: Gateway communication layer within the domain — delegates to IPaymentGatewayActionProvider.

Abstraction.name: GatewayOptions
Abstraction.Description: Options builder ported from Spree::Payment::GatewayOptions — constructs the options hash sent to payment gateways.
Abstraction.Purpose: Value object carrying order context (email, currency, addresses) to the gateway.

Category.name: Payment Methods
Category.Description: Configurable payment method definitions with webhook support.

Abstraction.name: PaymentMethod
Abstraction.Description: Aggregate root representing a configured payment method (e.g. Credit Card, Check, Store Credit). Supports soft deletion, parameterization, and webhooks.
Abstraction.Purpose: Define available payment methods with provider type, display rules, and preferences.
Abstraction.Contract: Invariant: Name is required and non-empty; ProviderType is required; Active defaults to true; Position >= 0

Abstraction.name: CheckPaymentMethod
Abstraction.Description: Concrete payment method for check-based payments — mirrors Spree::PaymentMethod::Check.
Abstraction.Purpose: Factory creating PaymentMethod with ProviderType="Check" for manual processing.

Abstraction.name: StoreCreditPaymentMethod
Abstraction.Description: Concrete payment method for store credit payments — mirrors Spree::PaymentMethod::StoreCredit.
Abstraction.Purpose: Factory creating PaymentMethod with ProviderType="StoreCredit" for credit-based payments.

Abstraction.name: DisplayOn
Abstraction.Description: Display visibility: Both, Frontend, Backend.

Category.name: Gateways
Category.Description: Payment gateway abstraction layer with Bogus test gateway.

Abstraction.name: IPaymentGatewayActionProvider
Abstraction.Description: Contract for payment gateway operations — Authorize, Capture, Purchase, Void, Cancel, Credit.
Abstraction.Purpose: Boundary abstraction isolating domain from concrete gateway implementations.

Abstraction.name: Gateway
Abstraction.Description: Base gateway class ported from Spree::Gateway. Provides exchange multiplier, options, and actions list.
Abstraction.Purpose: Abstract base with dollar-to-cent conversion and gateway metadata.

Abstraction.name: BogusGateway
Abstraction.Description: Test-only gateway ported from Spree::Gateway::Bogus — simulates payment gateway for development/testing with test card numbers.
Abstraction.Purpose: Enable integration testing without real payment provider credentials.
Abstraction.Contract: Invariant: Test card numbers in VALID_CCS always succeed; all other card numbers fail; authorizations prefixed with 'BGS-'

Abstraction.name: GatewayCustomer
Abstraction.Description: Gateway customer profile ported from Spree::GatewayCustomer — stores reference to external gateway customer ID.
Abstraction.Purpose: Link local users to external payment gateway profiles.

Abstraction.name: PaymentGatewayResponse
Abstraction.Description: Gateway response wrapper ported from Spree::PaymentResponse — captures success, message, authorization code, AVS/CVV results.
Abstraction.Purpose: Standardized response object consumed by Payment.Processing methods.

Category.name: Store Credits
Category.Description: Store credit lifecycle — issuance, authorization, capture, void, credit, and expiry.

Abstraction.name: StoreCredit
Abstraction.Description: Aggregate root tracking store credit balance, state machine (Active → Inactive/Expired/Depleted), and user association.
Abstraction.Purpose: Manage customer store credit balances with authorization/capture semantics.
Abstraction.Contract: Invariant: Amount >= 0; AmountUsed + AmountAuthorized <= Amount; State transitions follow Active -> Inactive -> Expired or -> Depleted

Abstraction.name: StoreCreditExtensions
Abstraction.Description: Static extension methods: Issue, Authorize, Capture, Void, Credit, Expire, AmountRemaining, IsActive, IsExpired.
Abstraction.Purpose: Factory and lifecycle methods — port of Spree::StoreCredit business logic.

Abstraction.name: StoreCreditType
Abstraction.Description: Aggregate root classifying store credits into named types with optional code.
Abstraction.Purpose: Categorize store credits (e.g. Gift Card, Loyalty, Adjustment) for reporting and business rules.
Abstraction.Contract: Invariant: Name is required and non-empty; Name length <= MaxNameLength; Code is unique when set

Abstraction.name: StoreCreditState
Abstraction.Description: Credit lifecycle states: Active, Inactive, Expired, Depleted.

Category.name: Store Credit Events
Category.Description: Event audit log for all store credit actions.

Abstraction.name: StoreCreditEvent
Abstraction.Description: Entity recording every action (Authorize, Capture, Void, Credit, Allocation) on a store credit with running user total.
Abstraction.Purpose: Audit trail — all store credit mutations must create a StoreCreditEvent record.
Abstraction.Contract: Invariant: Amount > 0; Action is a valid StoreCreditAction; StoreCreditId != default

Abstraction.name: StoreCreditAction
Abstraction.Description: Store credit event actions: Authorize, Capture, Void, Credit, Allocation.

Abstraction.name: StoreCreditCategory
Abstraction.Description: Aggregate root classifying store credits into categories with presentation label.
Abstraction.Purpose: Group store credits (e.g. Gift Card, Promotional) for reporting.
Abstraction.Contract: Invariant: Name is required and non-empty; Name length <= MaxNameLength

Category.name: Credit Cards
Category.Description: Payment card token storage with sensitive data handling.

Abstraction.name: CreditCard
Abstraction.Description: Aggregate root storing tokenized credit card metadata (brand, last4, expiry). Supports soft deletion and default card designation.
Abstraction.Purpose: Store minimal PCI-compliant card data for recurring payments.
Abstraction.Contract: Invariant: Month between 1 and 12; Year >= current year; Last4 length equals 4; Brand is required and within max length

Category.name: Refunds
Category.Description: Payment refund processing with reason tracking.

Abstraction.name: Refund
Abstraction.Description: Aggregate root for refund transactions against completed payments.
Abstraction.Purpose: Process and track refunds with amount, reason, and refunder attribution.
Abstraction.Contract: Invariant: Amount > 0; PaymentId != default; RefunderId == null or refers to an authenticated user

Abstraction.name: RefundReason
Abstraction.Description: Aggregate root for refund reason definitions (e.g. Return, Cancellation, Adjustment). Supports soft deletion and parameterization.
Abstraction.Purpose: Define selectable reasons for customer refunds.
Abstraction.Contract: Invariant: Name is required and non-empty; Active defaults to true; Code is unique when set

Category.name: Payment Capture Events
Category.Description: Audit trail for partial and full payment captures.

Abstraction.name: PaymentCaptureEvent
Abstraction.Description: Entity recording individual capture amounts against a payment. Supports partial captures.
Abstraction.Purpose: Track capture history — each gateway capture creates an event record.
Abstraction.Contract: Invariant: Amount > 0; PaymentId != default; CreatedAtUtc is set on creation

Mechanism.name: Payment Processing Pipeline
Mechanism.Description: (1) PaymentExtensions.Create creates a payment in Checkout state, (2) Payment.Processing.Process delegates to Authorize or Purchase based on AutoCapture, (3) Gateway communicates via IPaymentGatewayActionProvider, (4) On success, state transitions to Pending (authorize) or Completed (purchase), (5) Capture finalizes authorized payments, (6) Void/Cancel reverse before settlement.

Mechanism.name: Store Credit Authorization Flow
Mechanism.Description: StoreCreditExtensions.Issue creates a credit in Active state. Authorize reserves an amount (reducing available balance). Capture deducts from authorized and moves to Used. Void releases the hold. Credit reverses a previous capture. Expire transitions the remaining balance to unavailable. Depleted state is automatic when balance reaches zero.

Mechanism.name: Gateway Abstraction
Mechanism.Description: IPaymentGatewayActionProvider defines the contract for all gateway operations. Gateway is the abstract base with common behavior (exchange rate, preferences). BogusGateway provides a test implementation with known test card numbers. Concrete providers (Stripe, Adyen) are implemented in Infrastructure/Gateways/.

AntiPattern.name: Direct Payment State Mutation
AntiPattern.Avoid: Setting Payment.State directly without using the extension methods.
AntiPattern.BetterApproach: Always use Process, Complete, Fail, Void via PaymentExtensions which enforce valid state transitions.
AntiPattern.Impact: Invalid state transitions can lead to order fulfillment with unprocessed payments.

AntiPattern.name: EF Core in Domain
AntiPattern.Avoid: Importing EF Core types (IQueryable, DbContext) into domain entities.
AntiPattern.BetterApproach: Domain entities stay pure POCOs. Repository abstractions live in Persistence layer.

AntiPattern.name: Hardcoded Gateway Credentials
AntiPattern.Avoid: Embedding payment provider API keys or secrets in domain code.
AntiPattern.BetterApproach: Use GatewayOptions/Preferences pattern — secrets come from configuration and are injected through the infrastructure layer.
AntiPattern.Impact: PCI/SOX compliance violation; credential exposure in source control.
